components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared primary action. Host must supply canonical --pxo-* variables and Plex fonts.
components.css: .ds-primary { box-sizing: border-box; max-inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--pxo-border-control); border-radius: var(--pxo-radius-sm); background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text); font: var(--pxo-reading-control-weight) var(--pxo-reading-control-size) / var(--pxo-reading-control-line-height) var(--pxo-reading-control-font-family); letter-spacing: var(--pxo-reading-control-letter-spacing); min-inline-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; background: var(--pxo-action-primary); color: var(--pxo-action-on-primary); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-action-primary-hover); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-action-primary-pressed); } .ds-primary[aria-pressed="true"]:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-surface); color: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-text); border-color: var(--pxo-interaction-focus); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pxo-interaction-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; border-style: dashed; background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text-dim); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Shared secondary action with pressed-state support.
components.css: .ds-secondary { box-sizing: border-box; max-inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--pxo-border-control); border-radius: var(--pxo-radius-sm); background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text); font: var(--pxo-reading-control-weight) var(--pxo-reading-control-size) / var(--pxo-reading-control-line-height) var(--pxo-reading-control-font-family); letter-spacing: var(--pxo-reading-control-letter-spacing); min-inline-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere;  } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-surface-hover); } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-surface-raised); } .ds-secondary[aria-pressed="true"]:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-surface); color: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-text); border-color: var(--pxo-interaction-focus); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pxo-interaction-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; border-style: dashed; background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text-dim); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Text input
components.description: Shared native entry control; invalid and disabled boundaries remain visible.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-title">Title</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-title" placeholder="What needs to happen?">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; color: var(--pxo-text); font: var(--pxo-reading-control-weight) var(--pxo-reading-control-size) / var(--pxo-reading-control-line-height) var(--pxo-reading-control-font-family); letter-spacing: var(--pxo-reading-control-letter-spacing); } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; max-inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--pxo-border-control); border-radius: var(--pxo-radius-sm); background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text); inline-size: 100%; min-inline-size: 0; font: var(--pxo-reading-input-weight) var(--pxo-reading-input-size) / var(--pxo-reading-input-line-height) var(--pxo-reading-input-font-family); letter-spacing: var(--pxo-reading-input-letter-spacing); caret-color: var(--pxo-interaction-focus); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--pxo-text-secondary); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pxo-interaction-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; border-style: dashed; background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text-dim); opacity: 1; } .ds-input[aria-invalid]:not([aria-invalid="false"]) { border-color: var(--pxo-status-danger); border-style: dashed; } .ds-input::selection { background: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-surface); color: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-text); }

components.name: Warden saved view
components.description: Study-specific current desktop view, built on the shared secondary button.
components.css: .ds-navitem { box-sizing: border-box; max-inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--pxo-border-control); border-radius: var(--pxo-radius-sm); background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text); font: var(--pxo-reading-control-weight) var(--pxo-reading-control-size) / var(--pxo-reading-control-line-height) var(--pxo-reading-control-font-family); letter-spacing: var(--pxo-reading-control-letter-spacing); min-inline-size: max(44px, 2.75rem); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere;  } .ds-navitem:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-surface-hover); } .ds-navitem:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-surface-raised); } .ds-navitem[aria-pressed="true"]:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-surface); color: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-text); border-color: var(--pxo-interaction-focus); } .ds-navitem:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pxo-interaction-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-navitem:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; border-style: dashed; background: var(--pxo-surface); color: var(--pxo-text-dim); opacity: 1; } .ds-navitem { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; text-align: left; gap: 1rem; border-color: transparent; background: transparent; padding-inline: .8rem; } .ds-navitem[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-text); background: var(--pxo-interaction-selection-surface); border-color: var(--pxo-border); } .ds-count { font: var(--pxo-reading-code-weight) var(--pxo-reading-code-size)/var(--pxo-reading-code-line-height) var(--pxo-font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The approved modern, minimalist cyberpunk direction combines neutral work surfaces, concentrated electric accents, readable Plex typography and precise Solid/Inset identity. Density serves the task; hierarchy and accessible controls carry the expression.
 This records shared visual guidance for the documentation application and the built Warden review study. Warden's composition is study-specific, not a template for every product. Its synthetic local state does not establish production capabilities or approve a Warden mark.
keyCharacteristics: Cool/Warm neutrals and independent Acid/electric Violet accents.
Plex Sans task text and Plex Mono identifiers.
Tonal separation, modest corners and visible interaction states.
Solid primary identity and Inset companion identity.
dos: Do bind shared visual values to canonical token roles.
Do preserve readable text, visible focus and complete labels as text grows.
Do attribute Warden composition and local behavior to this synthetic study.
donts: Don't create another palette or change status meaning with accent preferences.
Don't present Warden candidates as approved family assets.
Don't infer production integration or unperformed accessibility coverage from visual review.
